text:
morgan: deploy-bot just reported a promotionQuorum mismatch for redwood-api chart upgrade v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 in eu-west. canary pods look healthy but promotionQuorum=60% and observed 40% (2/5). do we want to take a manual lock or force promote? :eyes:

deploy-bot: automated check: promotion policy failed. details:
```
PromotionCheck:
  required: 60% (3/5)
  healthy: 40% (2/5)
  failing-replicas: redwood-api-7b9c8 (CrashLoopBackOff), redwood-api-7b9c9 (ImagePullBackOff)
Canary logs: kubelet pulled older node image on 2 nodes, imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
Suggested actions: acquire manual release lock OR rollback canary -> pin chart to v3.2.1
```

priya: :thinking_face: imagePullBackOff on two canary replicas, that's weird — we've been promoting images through the registry. any registry flaps?

liam: checked registry, no recent pushes. looks like those nodes had local cached images and kubelet refused the newer digest because `imagePullPolicy` was IfNotPresent. can confirm with `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=redwood-api -o wide`

sofia: quick thought: if we force-promote we risk partial rollout with mismatched binaries. i'd prefer a manual lock for 30m while we investigate and update the helm values to set `image.pullPolicy: Always` for the canary slice.

morgan: +1 to manual lock. also need to update release notes to mention `image.pullPolicy` fix and the mitigation steps. who can grab the lock and update notes?

liam: i can take the lock and update the runbook. i'll annotate the release with: `manual-lock: promotion-quota-gap` and set TTL 30m. will also open a quick PR to change values in the canary overlay: `values/canary.yaml` -> `image:
  pullPolicy: Always`

release-coordinator: acquiring manual lock now: `acquire-lock --release redwood-api --reason promotion-quota-gap --by liam --ttl 30m` :lock:

deploy-bot: lock acquired by liam. promotion suspended. automated backoff timer started (30m). please update release notes and create the hotfix PR.

priya: can someone also patch the helm chart version in the canary overlay to keep chart `appVersion` aligned? we saw v3.2.2 chart tries to pull image tag `2026-03-20-abcdef` but two nodes had stale local tags. small change but worth noting in notes.

liam: will include chart version verification in the PR. quick commands i'll run:
```
helm get values redwood-api-canary -n prod > /tmp/canary-values.yaml
# update image.pullPolicy, bump overlay annotation
git checkout -b fix/canary-pullpolicy
# push PR and link here
```

sofia: after PR merged, can we re-run the promotion check by triggering the deploy-bot dry-run? i want to avoid manual rollback if we can just re-evaluate after nodes pull the right image.

morgan: yes. plan: 1) liam grabs lock and opens PR, 2) merge and wait for fleet to pick up image (or force `kubectl rollout restart` on canary pods), 3) re-run promotion check. if still failing, we rollback to v3.2.1 and cut a hotfix release. everyone ok?

priya: ok by me. i'll monitor metrics and keep an eye on SLO graphs.

liam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/charts/pulls/487 — includes `image.pullPolicy: Always` in canary values and a note to bump chart annotation for promotion verification. i'll add release notes draft in the PR description.

release-coordinator: noted. manual lock TTL 30m. if we need extension react `:thumbsup:` on this thread and i'll extend.

morgan: thanks all — tagging ops to watch node image caches: @sofia please ping infra if we see more ImagePullBackOffs.

sofia: will do. :thumbsup:
